output.reason: First-trimester vaginal bleeding heavier than spotting with lower abdominal cramping at about 8 weeks requires same-day hands-on assessment with ultrasound, blood tests and pelvic exam today, since ectopic pregnancy cannot be excluded by messaging.
output.patientMessage: Please be seen in person today at an emergency department or urgent early-pregnancy service. Bleeding heavier than spotting with cramping at 8 weeks needs an ultrasound, blood tests and exam today, because an ectopic pregnancy can't be ruled out remotely. Call 911 if you feel faint, develop severe or shoulder pain, or soak through a pad hourly. A Counsel clinician can help coordinate, but don't wait for a reply.
